en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To obtain knowledge about the methodology of both the basic and advanced methods of measuring the abiotic parameters of the aquatic environment and sampling of various communities of aquatic organisms.

en.content: 1.Instrumentation used for field measurement (multimeters, stratification of temperature, transparency) (allowance 0/0)2.Sampling for chemical analyses (allowance 0/0)3.Sediment sampling (allowance 0/0)4.Sampling and processing of bacteria samples (allowance 0/0)5.Sampling of phytoplankton and phytobenthos (allowance 0/0)6.Sampling and processing of zooplankton samples (allowance 0/0)7.Sampling and processing of macrozoobenthos (allowance 0/0)8.Sampling and processing of macrophytes (allowance 0/0)9.Modern limnological methods (allowance 0/0)10.Methods of fish sampling (allowance 0/0)
